resources.string: Download fresh artwork for your library and watch list as you browse, preserving your items and watch progress.

The app will clear cached images and artwork details, then restart. Posters download again as you browse, so an internet connection is needed. Your library, watch history, resume positions, accounts and settings are preserved. This does not upload anything to Simkl.
